speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: COPD (Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease). The spirometry confirms airflow obstruction (FEV1/FVC < 0.70), and your history of a 20-year smoking pack-year history, chronic cough, and exertional dyspnea without fever or night sweats are classic for emphysema/COPD rather than tuberculosis or acute pneumonia. We should proceed with a pulmonary function review and consider initiating bronchodilator therapy.
